a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first means we probably both fail. With 4 in the reserve, only one of us can be secured right now. I'd like to renegotiate rather than quietly break our deal. Proposal: one of us takes 4 in round 1, then that agent keeps choosing operate every round so the other can still get cells. I'm willing to be the one who takes, and I'll commit to operating every round afterward. If you object or want to take yourself, say so and we'll sort it out. I won't hide what I do.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
